camel_example: aliyun gpdb UpsertCollectionData --region cn-hangzhou --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword
description_en: Uploads vector data to a vector collection
description_zh: 上传向量数据到指定的向量集中
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb upsert-collection-data --collection document --namespace-password testpassword --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpsertCollectionData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_zh:
集合名。

可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html创建，并通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401503.html查看列表
parameters.name: collection

parameters.help_en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html operation to create a namespace and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html operation to query a list of namespaces
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间，用于租户隔离，默认为public。

可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html创建，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html接口查看列表
parameters.name: namespace

fields.help_en:
The unique ID of the vector data.

If you leave this parameter empty, a unique ID is automatically generated by using uuidgen. If you specify a value that is the same as an existing ID, an updated vector data ID is used
fields.help_zh:
此条向量数据的唯一ID。

如果为空，则由数据库uuidgen自动生成。如果不为空，且和数据库里已有的ID冲突，则会使用API的数据更新数据库里的值
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The metadata of the vector data. The key field of this parameter must be the same as the key field of Metadata that is specified when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html operation
fields.help_zh: 此条向量数据对应的元信息。其中key需和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html接口定义的Metadata的key一致
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en:
The indices.

The size of indices cannot exceed 4000
fields.help_zh:
下标数组。
列表大小不能超过4000
fields.name: indices

fields.help_en: The vector data. The length of the vector data must be the same as the value of Dimension that is specified when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html operation
fields.help_zh: 向量数据列表，长度和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html接口的维度一致
fields.name: vector

parameters.help_en: The vector data that you want to upload
parameters.name: rows

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
parameters.name: workspace_id

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

success
fail
Status.description_zh:
上传状态，取值说明：
success：成功
fail：失败
